dataset_name: NEXUS Technologies — NODUS Stage 7B Shared Enterprise Knowledge
description: Four permission-shared selectable sources containing authored enterprise documentation, catalog assertions, contracts, decisions and definitions. No precomputed investigation graph.

file_inventory.note: Self-checksum omitted to avoid a circular manifest hash

schema_conventions.format: UTF-8 JSON, two-space indentation; named top-level arrays for collection files; manifest is a top-level object
schema_conventions.record_envelope: All source records expose id, source_id, source_record_type, author_employee_id, created_at, revised_at, revision_number, status, access_classification
schema_conventions.id_format: NEX-SRC-*, NEX-DOC-*, NEX-CAT-*, NEX-IFC-*, NEX-ADR-*, NEX-TERM-*; all globally unique within Stage 7B
schema_conventions.timestamps: UTC ISO 8601 timestamps ending Z; decision_date and effective_date are YYYY-MM-DD calendar dates
schema_conventions.optional_values: Explicit null for Stage 7A platform services without owning_project_id; otherwise typed arrays and fields rather than nested canonical entities
schema_conventions.content_model: Text/markdown documents; typed field specifications for contracts; documented catalog assertions, not observed runtime events
schema_conventions.source_authority: Documents are published engineering knowledge, catalog is service-owner declaration, contracts are owner-approved expected interfaces, ADRs are accepted historical decisions

foreign_key_conventions.parent_entity_ids: All NEX-PRJ, NEX-TEAM, NEX-EMP, NEX-SVC, NEX-ROLE, NEX-ENT, NEX-SOA and NEX-DEP IDs resolve only against immutable Stage 7A
foreign_key_conventions.same_stage_record_ids: source_id, referenced_document_ids, referenced_contract_ids, linked_contract_ids, related_source_record_ids resolve to Stage 7B records
foreign_key_conventions.dependency_direction: Stage 7A source_service_id is consumer/dependent, target_service_id is upstream provider; source order retained verbatim in catalog
foreign_key_conventions.event_publication_discrepancy: NEX-DEP-003 and NEX-DEP-008 prose describes source publisher -> target subscriber, conflicting with general dependency edge semantics. Neither edge is rewritten. Contract provider/known_consumer roles describe event flow without implying corrected canonical edges.
foreign_key_conventions.graph_boundary: References and prose represent evidence to ingest; no Neo4j nodes, inferred edges, agent findings or relationship confidence are precomputed

recommended_future_ingestion_order: Load Stage 7A first and validate its canonical IDs and permissions
Load Stage 7B source_registry.json (selectable source boundaries and ACL)
Load record identities and content from shared_documents.json, interface_contracts.json, service_catalog_records.json, architecture_decisions.json, technical_glossary.json
Resolve cross-record links in a deferred second pass because document and contract references can be cyclic
Store source IDs, revision dates and claim provenance separately from later observed or inferred graph evidence
